criteria.label: Gold purity confirmed
criteria.ask: Karat stated for the exact item (10K / 14K / 18K / 22K / 24K).

criteria.label: Explicit "solid gold" wording
criteria.ask: The listing itself says solid gold — not plated, vermeil, filled, overlay or tone.

criteria.label: Hallmark + maker's mark
criteria.ask: A karat stamp plus the maker/manufacturer mark on the piece.

criteria.label: Weight in grams published
criteria.ask: The seller publishes the metal weight so the gold value can be checked.

criteria.label: Independent seller reputation
criteria.ask: BBB record and verified contact details for the business.

criteria.label: Price vs gold value
criteria.ask: Asking price compared with the raw gold the ring contains.

criteria.label: Return policy you can use
criteria.ask: A stated return window, and what voids it (resizing, engraving, custom).

criteria.label: Reversible payment
criteria.ask: Pay by credit card so a chargeback is possible.

criteria.label: Documentation kept
criteria.ask: Listing, receipt, description and the seller's purity claim retained.

criteria.label: Independent check on arrival
criteria.ask: Take it to an independent jeweller before wearing or resizing.

criteria.label: Professional purity test
criteria.ask: Ask for XRF or another professional test, not just the stamp.

criteria.label: Walk away if refused
criteria.ask: If the seller will not allow independent verification or a return, do not buy.

hallmark.label: US quality-mark rule
hallmark.text: 16 CFR Part 23 governs quality marks on gold jewellery; § 23.10 covers additional guidance for the use of quality marks.

solid.label: FTC solid-gold rule
solid.text: The FTC explains that "solid gold" is about the piece not being hollow, not about it being unplated.

payment.label: FTC online shopping guidance
payment.text: The FTC recommends paying by credit card online because card payments carry dispute rights.

xrf.label: GIA lab notes on XRF limits
xrf.text: GIA documented a resin-cored electroformed piece that read 17.99K-22.47K on XRF, so a surface XRF reading alone is not proof.

cartier.caveat: personalised/engraved pieces excluded; Maison quality-control inspection

mene.caveat: only 7 days; up to 10% restocking fee; lifetime buyback at daily metal value minus 10%
